notes: Source CHEP_WEIGHT, without reweighting or population scaling.
LIKELYVOTER is a native model; its two classes are not administrative vote histories.
All 50 source states queried; D.C. has no source sample, never a zero turnout.
Native categories are explicitly coarsened, not arbitrary products or split bins.
Small and complementary groups have no public raw counts or weight primitives.
Both within-state and cross-state complements are held to preserve prior pooled-source disclosure limits.
Unknowns remain in the full state denominator; omitted groups are not redistributed.
No design CI, measured staying home, demographic register count or local allocation.
Field period, population calibration and state representativeness remain unqualified.
